error-message-mismatches-actual-error: A form shows a fluent, field-specific error message, but it describes the wrong problem for the value you actually typed, so you can't tell what's really wrong.
silent-redisplay-after-real-error: After a failed submission the form just reappears with your bad input (or even a success banner) and no error message, so you don't know the submission failed or why.
inline-error-adjacent-to-wrong-field: An error message sits visually next to the wrong field with no programmatic link, so you read it against the field it appears to belong to and get misled about what's in error.
error-summary-incoherent-with-flagged-st: A top-of-form error summary lists fields, counts, or links that don't match the fields actually flagged on the page, so you can't reliably tell what needs fixing.
non-text-only-error-indicator: A field is flagged as wrong using only colour, a red border, or an icon, with no words anywhere saying an error occurred, so a screen-reader user never learns there's a problem.
error-icon-text-alternative-misstates-er: An error icon has alt text, but the text is wrong, generic, or describes the icon's appearance instead of the actual error, so it doesn't tell a screen-reader user what's wrong.
